english.title: Remove / interfere with an immobilisation notice without authority
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..),

(A)_[removed]_
(B)_[interfered]_

with an immobilisation notice fixed to a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), without the authority of an authorised person or a person acting under the direction of an authorised person
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 6 of the Road Safety (Immobilisation, Removal and Disposal of Vehicles) Regulations 2009.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
removed/interfered with an immobilisation notice fixed to a vehicle

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Regulation 4(6) of the Road Safety (Immobilisation, Removal and Disposal of Vehicles) Regulations 2009 provides that immobilisation notice may not be removed or interfered with except by or on the authority of an authorised person or a person acting under the direction of an authorised person.
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant removed or interfered with an immobilisation notice fixed to a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) without the authority of an authorised person or a person acting under the direction of an authorised person.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level two on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

maxfinetypemagct.description: fine not exceeding level two on the legislative standard scale
